item.title: ष्ट्यु
item.description: ष्ट्यु = ष ट य उ (pointed+coracle) verb(connect) pointed chisel verb(connect) hook (pointed curve) connect as pratyay means place of instrument of action.

item.title: त्रल्
item.description: त्रल् = त्र ल float water sand meaning explained: as if floating sand in water sutra 5.3.7.

7.4.41 - 7.4.43 दधातेर्हिः SV: दधातेः हिः AV: ति किति Language Meaning: हि is substituted for धा (दधाति) before an affix beginning with त् and having an indicatory क् । Literal meaning : द ध अ ए of त ऋ ह इ roll carry till संप्रदान (float/that) superior hard below.

item.title: तद्धित
item.description: तद्धित = तत् (तन् + क्विप् ) + हित (धा + क्त ) तत् = that pull inside + maneuver wave rope हित = that carried.

item.title: क्विप्
item.description: क्विप् = क व इ प objectify (maneuver+wave) rope / footing meaning explained: wave like maneuver of rope or footing.
